name: @oge-ui/react-ai
description: React AI components from the OGE UI suite that work with any model: a natural-language grid assistant that turns "orders over 500 from last month, newest first" into validated sort, filter, grouping and column changes, with preview, apply and undo — running the same assistant machine, transports and stylesheet as the Angular @oge-ui/ai package. Bring your own model: OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, vLLM), Anthropic or your own backend; no hosted service, no row data sent.
author: kaya2m
